subject: Film & Cinema
title: Character Arcs: Change Over Story
description: A short lesson to help you apply Character Arcs: Change Over Story.

hook.text: Michael Corleone starts as a war hero and ends as a monster. That's a character arc.

buildup.text: An arc traces how a character transforms — or fails to transform — over the story.

discovery.text: Positive arcs show growth. Negative arcs show corruption. Flat arcs show steadfast conviction.

twist.text: Some great characters refuse to change — and that refusal becomes the tragedy.

climax.text: The arc gives the audience a reason to care beyond the plot's outcome.

punchline.text: Plot is what happens. Arc is why it matters.

quiz.question: What is a negative character arc?
options: The character deteriorates or becomes corrupted over the story
